job.job_description:
AI Engineer Agentic AI, RAG & GenAI




Location: Ambattur, Chennai
Employment Type: Contract 12 Months

Experience: 3+ Years

Notice Period: Immediate Joiners / Short Notice Preferred




About the Role




We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Generative AI, RAG, and Agentic AI to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying intelligent AI solutions and scalable ML applications.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and AI-powered applications.
Develop Agentic AI / AI Agents and multi-step intelligent workflows.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, Django, and Flask.
Build, train, evaluate, and fine-tune machine learning models.
Work with NLP, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
Integrate AI/ML models into production applications using REST APIs.
Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and optimization.
Work with SQL, NoSQL, and RDBMS databases.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and business stakeholders.
Deploy, monitor, and maintain AI/ML applications in production.



Required Skills

Python 3+ years
Machine Learning 3+ years
Generative AI / GenAI
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
Agentic AI / AI Agents
Django / Flask
NLP
LLMs
REST API development
SQL / RDBMS
NoSQL databases
Data Structures & Algorithms
Statistics & Machine Learning fundamentals

ML / AI Frameworks & Libraries

PyTorch / Keras
Scikit-learn
Pandas
NumPy
NLP libraries/frameworks
LLM frameworks and tools
Vector databases / semantic search



Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of relevant professional experience in AI/ML/NLP.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Good communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
